data.body:
Sweep implemented in worktree jw-ae96 (uncommitted).

BEFORE -> AFTER, three failure classes:
1. ruff check scripts/: 79 findings (50 T201 + 12 RUF100 + 11 E501 + 2 RUF005 + 2 RUF059 + 1 B905 + 1 RUF036) -> 0. Note the inventory in the description undercounted by one: an unlisted RUF036 (None-not-at-end-of-union, check_raw_git_writes.py:168) was also present and is fixed (safe autofix; annotation-only).
2. ruff format --check scripts/: 7 files would be reformatted -> 0 (44 already formatted).
3. T201 consolidation: nine single-file scripts/*.py per-file-ignores entries replaced by one "scripts/**" = ["T201"]; per-file-ignores 17 -> 9 entries. All 28 inline '# noqa: T201' directives across 13 files deleted in the same change, so no new RUF100.

Makefile sources = src tests -> src tests scripts. make lint green.

RUF100 directives naming rules NOT in select: 7 sites (4 rule names), not 5.
- capture_jira_fixtures.py:158,159 (PLC0415): bare directives; the lazy-import rationale is already stated in the comment directly above. Deleted, nothing lost.
- check_complexity_baseline.py:133 (S603 'fixed, non-shell argv'), jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py:75 (S310 'fixed localhost harness'), verify_mcp_publisher_pin.py:48 (S310 'fixed https GitHub release URL'), probe_rebar.py:257 (PLR0915 'deliberately one linear probe script'): each carried live rationale prose. The noqa mechanism was removed but the prose was kept as a plain trailing comment.
- jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py:81 (S310): bare duplicate of :75. Deleted.
Also one non-listed RUF100 with prose (jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py:294, unused BLE001) was likewise demoted to a plain comment.

Post-sweep IRREDUCIBLE exception count in scripts/: 24 per-site exceptions = 21 inline '# noqa' (17x E402 for sys.path-bootstrap imports across 6 files; 4x BLE001) + 3 'type: ignore'. Zero file-level 'ruff: noqa'. Zero T201 inline directives remain.

No-behaviour-change proof for the CI-invoked gates: all seven run byte-identical before/after (check_readme_quickstart differs only in a randomly generated ticket id). Differential positive-detection tests old-vs-new on synthetic fixtures also identical for check_wall_clock_asserts (3 findings incl. a chained comparison exercising the strict= zip), check_raw_git_writes (5 fixture findings + 113 whole-repo hits incl. marked ones), check_complexity_baseline (--check active=69 new=0 increased=0 stale=0), and check_commit_message_wrap.

Gates: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS, ruff check/format scripts/ clean, gen_types/gen_cli_reference/gen_mcp_reference/gen_env_registry --check all clean, targeted unit tests 356 passed.
